known_current_toolkit_gaps: LSB zone mob YAML is not represented by the current SQL-only logical table extractor.
No generic logical records currently model mob_skill_lists membership.
No generic logical records currently model mob_skills definitions as package dependencies.
No generic logical records currently model mob_spell_lists membership.
No generic species/family dependency layer currently closes Medusa/Lamia species relationships.
Lua require/mixin dependencies are not guaranteed to be represented as package artifact edges.
Arithmetic entity references such as ID.mob.MEDUSA + 1 through + 4 are not guaranteed to resolve to helper entities.
YAML loot item symbols are not currently guaranteed to resolve to canonical item records.
Zone text/title enum references are not currently guaranteed to become package dependencies.
Cross-zone/system-state dependencies such as Besieged are not yet modeled as conditional semantic dependencies independent of direct code references.
Current LSB Besieged mob lifecycle hooks are present but empty, so source-code traversal alone cannot prove Medusa retail/system behavior.
